result.summary: The main visual issue observed is the inconsistent and clipped text display for 'Trattoria Piccolo' and the inconsistent visual hierarchy of restaurant names.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated at the edge of the screen, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container padding or allow for multi-line text labels for restaurant names to ensure they are fully visible.

issues.description: Inconsistent alignment and text formatting for restaurant names across cards (e.g., Green Bowl Poké vs. Trattoria Piccolo).
issues.suggestion: Standardize the font size and container dimensions for all 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards to ensure a uniform visual experience.
